policy_document.title: Agency Procurement Authority & Approval Policy
policy_document.owner: Office of the Chief Procurement Officer

tier_2.policy: Section 4.2: Purchases $1,000 - $5,000 require Department Manager approval.

tier_3.policy: Section 4.3: Purchases over $5,000 require Procurement Committee approval.

prohibited_practices.title: Split purchasing
prohibited_practices.policy: Section 4.4: Splitting a single requirement into multiple smaller purchases to avoid an approval threshold is prohibited and must be referred to the Procurement Integrity Office.

prohibited_practices.title: Personal use
prohibited_practices.policy: Section 4.5: Agency funds may not be used for personal purchases or gift cards.
